name: manual_2f377d
claim: No blanket always-prefer-ours or always-prefer-theirs rule is correct for a 3-way merge conflict — read both sides and prefer the strict quality/robustness superset when one exists; when neither side dominates, combine compatible changes and stop for human review on remaining conflicts so unique valid content is not discarded.

decisions.notes: Supersedes lesson_005f2a16600d for PR #338: keep the strict-superset judgment rule and add the explicit non-dominating fallback (combine compatible changes; stop for human review on residual conflicts).

rationale: Supersedes lesson_005f2a16600d for PR #338: keep the strict-superset judgment rule and add the explicit non-dominating fallback (combine compatible changes; stop for human review on residual conflicts).
